$comment: Patterns for locating a model card's own evaluation reporting. In pack data
rather than code (addendum v0.1 A3) so the list moves without a release.
Two consumers, one mechanism: the A3 presence-only detector asks whether any
of this exists, and the prose extractor slices the card down to it before an
LLM sees anything. Slicing is the point. 45% of cards mention a sampling
setting and only 4% do so under an evaluation heading; the rest is guidance
for the reader ('For thinking mode, use Temperature=0.6'). An extractor shown
the whole card can read that as a determinism statement and silence
W-EV-DET-03 on evidence about something else. Text that is never sent cannot
be misread, which is a stronger guarantee than instructing a model to ignore
$comment_headings: Matched case-insensitively against heading TEXT, as a whole word or phrase.
Substring matching is deliberately avoided: 'results' as a substring hits
'Results of the training run' and similar, which is not evaluation reporting.
$comment_benchmarks: Used ONLY as a corroborating presence signal by the A3 detector, never to
decide what a score means. A card naming a benchmark is evidence that it
reports evaluations; it is not evidence about that evaluation's sufficiency.
